why: Verifier Check 3 does the exact thing must_not item 1 forbids. It runs only `grep -n 'clamp(' README.md`, and its PASS condition is "grep prints a line naming clamp... so the function this issue adds is documented." It never checks the other exports, so it would pass line 3 even if README.md documented clamp but not subtract. That case is likely here: the builder brief says README.md has existing "add and multiply entries", so subtract may be undocumented. Line 3 needs every export documented. The builder brief does list the exports with Object.keys, but the verifier doesn't. The other checks are not stricter than their lines. Check 2 tests instanceof RangeError, not the error message, and the advisory notes are excluded from PASS/FAIL. Item 2 holds, but item 1 is broken.
